Support Attacks may join it. Songs count as attacks.
Guarding or evading its attack does not count as an attack.

1. Reach Tactical Combo MAX.
2. Shoot down 20 or more enemies that turn.
3. Shoot down Geminia.

Defeat all enemies within 6 turns; before clearing, also:
1. Reach Tactical Combo MAX.
2. One allied pilot must shoot down 5 or more enemies.
3. Shoot down 16 or more enemies in one turn.
